draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER meets the pre-specified robustness criterion (mean test F1 drop of at most 2.0 points) at all evaluated label-noise rates, with drops of 0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points at 10%, 20% and 30% noise respectively.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops of 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion. The evidence supports a stronger, more precise claim than the hedged "somewhat robust."
